text: LUXCUSTOMS started with a simple frustration — watching cars come back from 'premium' shops with crooked tint edges and buffer trails in the paint. We built a studio where the work is slow on purpose, measured twice and inspected three times.
Our Springvale bay is lit like an operating theatre — full-spectrum LEDs that reveal every swirl, speck and edge. If we can see a flaw under these lights, it doesn't leave the studio.

Film is computer-cut, never trimmed on your glass. Paint depth is measured before a pad touches a panel. Coatings are applied panel-by-panel with cure times respected, not rushed. This is detailing as a discipline.
An honest quote, a firm deadline, and a handover walkthrough where we show you the car under the lights. If something isn't right, we fix it before you drive away — that's the whole deal.
